question: Which state government announced the launch of 'CM Shri Schools', modeled on the central government’s PM SHRI scheme?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Haryana.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Haryana Education Minister Mahipal Dhanda announced the launch of 'CM Shri Schools' during the Budget Session on February 25, 2026.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The 'CM Shri Schools' initiative is a state-level program modeled after the central government's PM SHRI Schools scheme.**
 
• These schools will follow the **CBSE curriculum** and aim to implement the **National Education Policy (NEP) 2020** effectively.
 
• The primary objective is to create model institutions that focus on **21st-century skills**, holistic development, and providing benchmarks for neighboring schools.
 
• Haryana Education Initiatives__
 __
 
• Current Education Minister - Mahipal Dhanda
 
• Focus - Inclusive and modern education infrastructure
 
• PM SHRI Schools in State - Approximately 250 schools selected
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• PM SHRI Schools__

 __
 
• Launched in **2022**, it stands for Pradhan Mantri Schools for Rising India.
 
• It is a centrally sponsored scheme to upgrade over **14,500 schools** across the country.
 
 
 
• National Education Policy (NEP) 2020__
 __
 
• Replaced the 1986 policy, focusing on a **5+3+3+4** pedagogical structure.
 
 
 
• CBSE (Central Board of Secondary Education)__
 __
 
• A national level board of education in India for public and private schools, controlled and managed by the Government of India.
 
 
 
• Holistic Development__
 
 
• An approach to learning that emphasizes the importance of the physical, emotional, and psychological well-being of students alongside academics.
